name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Communications & Content Strategist
summary: Communications strategist with 15+ years writing and managing content and messaging for B2B and consumer audiences, including long-form thought leadership, short-form campaign copy, and organic social content that has driven measurable audience growth. Builds messaging frameworks that adapt a consistent voice across different audiences, and is comfortable working directly in CMS and web platforms to keep content current. Holds a B.A. with a minor in Political Science and brings genuine, long-standing engagement with Colorado and national politics to this work.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Write and publish thought leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides on systems architecture, CRM optimization, and operational growth for B2B audiences.
Design and promote a free digital-footprint audit offer through organic LinkedIn content and outreach, enrolling 180+ businesses to date.
Draft clean, specific direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline.
Build reusable messaging frameworks and templates, adapting a consistent voice and structure to each client's brand and audience rather than starting from scratch.
Install and configure Google Tag Manager on every website built at Solenzo, and guide clients through their own CMS platforms to keep content current.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Produced high-converting campaign assets and conversion-focused copy on deadline across concurrent client accounts.
Managed integrated marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal departments.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Advised a network of 15-20 partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, equipping them to communicate product value clearly to their own customers.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates.
Managed and developed a 20-person, later 8-person, onboarding team, training new hires and building staff enablement materials.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
